why: The first star past the end of its central hydrogen, with the energy of contraction on (grav=1): G 1e-17, s 1.5152, 1.25 M_Ch, the ladder star sitting on the explosion line (its processed core is 0.81 M_Ch, so it explodes only if the core grows by 1.23). It starts from its plain run's checkpoint at exhaustion (from=) and runs to central hydrogen 1e-8, keeping a profile every 10 models, to measure how far the core grows in shell burning: the gate for computing the declared core growth g.
